main_text.p:
V. הַדְּבָרִים haddebarim, ò verba.
A. מִדִּבְרִים middebarim, à verbis.

p.i: Prima Declinatio est quæ completitur nomina masculini generis, quorum pluralis numerus definit in ים im, ut מֶלֶךְ me-lech. rex, מְלָכִים melachim, reges.
Interdum masculina in plurali definunt in ות oth, ut אָב ab, pater, אָבוֹת aboth patres.
Nomina specierum animalium sæpe in singulari numero capiuntur pluraliter, ut בָּקָר bakár, bos & boues.
Secunda Declinatio est quæ completitur nomina fœminini generis, quorum pluralis numerus definit in ות oth, ut חֶרֶב chereb, gladius, חַרְבוֹת charaboth, gladij.
Multa fœminina in plurali definunt in ים

page.notes: Hebrew is printed with vowel points; transcribed as shown but the vowel-pointed forms are reproduced approximately from the scan. Line-end hyphens reflect the printed "me-lech", "com-plettitur" style breaks. The word "completitur" in the first paragraph is printed as "completi-tur" with a long s-form; read as "completitur". Ligature and long-s forms normalised to plain s. Multiple words at the start of "Interdum" and "Nomina" lines are italic in the print. The "p 4" at the lower right is a catchword or signature-like mark and is recorded as a catchword candidate rather than a page number. Final line ends mid-sentence at the column foot; the sentence continues on the next page.
